name: learning-coach
description: A multi-Skill learning system with Topic-local coaching, portfolio planning, request-scoped research coaching, read-only views, and a private GitHub-backed Learning Vault.

interface.shortDescription: Learn inside Topics, plan across learning, and advance research on request
interface.longDescription: Learning Coach is a multi-Skill learning system backed by a user-owned GitHub Learning Vault. Topic Coach runs Topic-local learning, Ask Coach plans across the learning portfolio, Research Coach activates only for explicit research intent and can work with a separately owned Idea Vault, Knowledge Inbox captures reusable chat fragments without creating Topics, Learning View presents state read-only, and Vault Curator maintains the Learning Vault. Research and learner state remain separate authorities. The Plugin requires the canonical GitHub app and never requires PATs or private infrastructure.
defaultPrompt: Resume one of my learning Topics and continue from the next useful step.
Based on my Learning Vault, what should I learn, review, practice, or defer next?
Help me evaluate or advance a research idea without mixing it into learner state.
